title: [dynamo] including Python 3.14 internal headers won't compile in MSVC C++
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Issue with compiling with Python 3.14 on windows
```
C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\pytorch\.ci\pytorch\windows\Python\include\internal/pycore_stackref.h(254): error C7555: use of designated initializers requires at least '/std:c++20'
C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\pytorch\.ci\pytorch\windows\Python\include\internal/pycore_stackref.h(455): error C7555: use of designated initializers requires at least '/std:c++20'
C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\pytorch\.ci\pytorch\windows\Python\include\internal/pycore_stackref.h(455): error C2737: 'PyStackRef_NULL': const object must be initialized
C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\pytorch\.ci\pytorch\windows\Python\include\internal/pycore_stackref.h(536): error C7555: use of designated initializers requires at least '/std:c++20'
C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\pytorch\.ci\pytorch\windows\Python\include\internal/pycore_stackref.h(546): error C7555: use of designated initializers requires at least '/std:c++20'
C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\pytorch\.ci\pytorch\windows\Python\include\internal/pycore_stackref.h(556): error C7555: use of designated initializers requires at least '/std:c++20'
C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\pytorch\.ci\pytorch\windows\Python\include\internal/pycore_stackref.h(559): error C7555: use of designated initializers requires at least '/std:c++20'
C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\pytorch\.ci\pytorch\windows\Python\include\internal/pycore_stackref.h(570): error C7555: use of designated initializers requires at least '/std:c++20'
C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\pytorch\.ci\pytorch\windows\Python\include\internal/pycore_stackref.h(581): error C7555: use of designated initializers requires at least '/std:c++20'
[6993/7185] Building CXX object caffe2\torch\CMakeFiles\torch_python.dir\csrc\autograd\python_function.cpp.obj
[6994/7185] Building CXX object caffe2\torch\CMakeFiles\torch_python.dir\csrc\autograd\python_variable.cpp.obj
[6995/7185] Building CXX object caffe2\torch\CMakeFiles\torch_python.dir\csrc\dynamo\framelocals_mapping.cpp.obj
FAILED: caffe2/torch/CMakeFiles/torch_python.dir/csrc/dynamo/framelocals_mapping.cpp.obj 
```

Looks like its complaining about these https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.14.0rc1/Include/internal/pycore_stackref.h#L274C1-L274C71

Related issues: 
https://github.com/cython/cython/issues/6783
and
https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/130931

This is happening with 3.14 rc1

Options to mitigate this:
1) Try compiling with ./std:c++20 or whatever it suggests
2) Try to get this fixed upstream and wait until it's fixed
3) Don't include pycore_xxx headers in C++. They're intended to be internal only and CPython is a C, not C++ project so this kinda thing is going to break frequently. The thing PyTorch has done in other places is to make a small C file that includes whatever headers we care about like pycore_code.h and re-expose the important functionality as functions to be used in C++


For enabling 3.14 builds will fallback on option 3.14 however we need to fix it in dynamo.

Pr Enabling 3.14 Windows builds:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/159869

cc @ezyang @gchanan @zou3519 @kadeng @msaroufim @malfet @seemethere @chauhang @penguinwu @albanD @williamwen42 

### Versions

2.9.0
